If the project actually uses `unittest`, a different layout (`tests/` directory), or a runner like `tox`/`nox`, tell me which and I'll adjust the section to match.

 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests are run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/):
+
+```sh
+pip install pytest
+pytest
+```
+
+Run a single file or test with:
+
+```sh
+pytest test_pricing_cache.py
+pytest test_pricing_cache.py::test_lookup_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
